Aitken Spence profit nearly doubles in six months 📈

Aitken Spence PLC (SPEN) made a profit of Rs 1.83 billion for shareholders in the six months to September 2026. That is 97% more than a year ago.

In the July to September quarter, revenue grew 6% to Rs 22.76 billion and profit before tax rose 67% to Rs 1.07 billion. Profit for shareholders in the quarter was Rs 381 million, 4% lower than a year ago.

The shipping and logistics business grew strongly, while hotels made a loss in this off season.

Source: SPEN interim financial statements, Colombo Stock Exchange, https://cdn.cse.lk/cmt/upload_report_file/501_1794475725702.pdf
